title: Anna's Town
text:
Anna lives in a small town. There is a big park near her home. In the park, there is a lake with ducks. Every Sunday, Anna walks there with her dog.

The town has a bakery on Main Street. Anna buys bread there every morning. Next to the bakery is a library. Her friend Tom works in the library.

questions.text: Why does Anna walk in the park every Sunday?
options: She likes the park and enjoys walking there with her dog
She is looking for her friend Tom

questions.text: What can we say about Anna from the passage?

vocabulary.definition: a green place with grass and trees where people walk
a large area of water surrounded by land
a shop that sells bread and cakes
a place where you can borrow books

paragraph_translations: Анна живе в маленькому місті. Біля її дому є великий парк. У парку є озеро з качками. Кожної неділі Анна гуляє там зі своїм собакою.
У місті є пекарня на головній вулиці. Анна купує там хліб щоранку. Поруч із пекарнею є бібліотека. Її друг Том працює в бібліотеці.
